description: Navigate the app to a route path (e.g. '/pokemon/25' or '/settings'). Use a concrete path — resolve any dynamic segments (like [id]) to real values first. See get_routes with includeSitemap:true for valid paths. Pushes by default (back still works); pass replace:true to leave the current screen instead of stacking on top of it (e.g. resetting to '/').

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

observe.description: What to return after navigating. Default "screen": the route it landed on and what is on screen. "none" skips it.

path.description: The concrete path to navigate to, e.g. '/pokemon/25'.

replace.description: Replace the current screen instead of pushing (use when resetting, e.g. to '/').

name: navigate
